item.title: How Management Controls is driving contractor compliance across industries
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with Chrissy Jacobson of Management Controls about her role in the Future Leaders program and how the initiative is helping emerging professionals grow their networks across the industry.

item.title: Chevron ordered to suspend production at Leviathan gas field offshore Israel
item.description: The government said Israel's energy needs would be met through alternative sources and that the electricity sector was prepared to operate power stations using alternative fuels if necessary.

item.title: Texas grid sees 233 GW in data center requests: How much is real?
item.description: Grid planners are drowning in connection requests. More than 233 GW of large-load interconnection applications now sit in ERCOT’s queue, with over 70% coming from data centers.

item.title: Protecting the workforce from head to toe
item.description: "Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes." The familiar children’s nursery rhyme is lighthearted and simple, yet its message resonates well beyond childhood.

item.title: Berry’s passion is elevating the demolition industry
item.description: Doug Berry, president of United Dismantling & Salvage, built the company from the ground up in the first half of the 2020s and has changed how demolition works with his unique blend of operational experience and employee expertise.

item.title: Louisiana selects 19 FastSites in historic state investment
item.description: Through FastSites, Louisiana, is investing capital through a first-of-its-kind, state-led framework designed to strengthen site and infrastructure readiness before companies come calling.

item.title: Energy Department approves export expansion at Cheniere's Corpus Christi LNG terminal
item.description: The authorization allows additional exports of up to 0.47 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of U.S. natural gas as LNG to non-Free Trade Agreement (non-FTA) countries from Trains 8 and 9 of the Corpus Christi Stage 3 Project.

item.title: Shintech Louisiana announces $3.4B expansion
item.description: The project includes construction of a second ethylene unit and a fourth chlor-alkali and vinyl chloride monomer unit at the company’s existing Iberville Parish facility, marking the next phase of the company’s long-term growth in Louisiana.

item.title: Engineering reliable natural gas valve automation for sour service applications
item.description: For operators focused on reliability, safety and long-term performance, engineered natural gas valve automation is not simply best practice — it is a strategic investment in operational continuity.
